mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_knowledge_document (title, category, source_type, original_filename, char_count, chunk_count, status, uploader_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{sourceType}, #{originalFilename}, #{charCount}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{uploaderId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, category, source_type, original_filename, char_count, chunk_count, status, uploader_id, create_time, update_time FROM agent_knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

SELECT id, title, category, source_type, original_filename, char_count, chunk_count, status, uploader_id, create_time, update_time FROM agent_knowledge_document WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_knowledge_document SET chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, char_count = #{charCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_knowledge_chunk (doc_id, chunk_index, heading, content, keywords, embedding, embedding_model, embedding_dim, create_time) VALUES (#{chunk.docId}, #{chunk.chunkIndex}, #{chunk.heading}, #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.keywords}, #{chunk.embedding}, #{chunk.embeddingModel}, #{chunk.embeddingDim}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, chunk_index, heading, content, keywords, embedding, embedding_model, embedding_dim, create_time FROM agent_knowledge_chunk WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY chunk_index

SELECT c.id, c.doc_id, c.chunk_index, c.heading, c.content, c.keywords, c.embedding, c.embedding_model, c.embedding_dim, c.create_time, d.title AS doc_title FROM agent_knowledge_chunk c JOIN agent_knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.doc_id AND d.status = 1 WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS chunkId, c.doc_id AS docId, d.title AS docTitle, c.heading AS heading, c.content AS content, MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{q} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS score FROM agent_knowledge_chunk c JOIN agent_knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.doc_id AND d.status = 1 WHERE MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{q} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
